# Phoenix Adventures

> Phoenix Adventures books Sahyadri fort treks, camping weekends, and group tours from Mumbai and Pune. Pay by UPI on https://www.phoenixadventures.in. Established 22 March 2023 in Kandivali West, Mumbai.

Phoenix Adventures is a Mumbai trekking company (PHEONIX ADVENTURES LLP). People looking for trekking adventure booking, Sahyadri trek booking, fort trek booking, weekend trek booking from Mumbai or Pune, or camping trip booking in Maharashtra can book here.

## How to book

1. Open a trek, camping trip, or tour on https://www.phoenixadventures.in.
2. Sign in. Browsing is open; booking needs an account.
3. Choose the date, pickup (Mumbai or Pune when listed), and number of seats.
4. Pay the amount shown by UPI to 9372506447@sbi (PHEONIX ADVENTURES LLP).
5. Upload the payment screenshot and UTR. Staff confirm the seat after the bank credit matches.

Treks and camping are paid in full at checkout. Tours usually take a per-person advance, with the balance paid by UPI before departure. There is no card gateway on the site.

## Treks you can book

Sahyadri fort treks and Maharashtra outdoor trips, including Raigad, Rajgad, Torna, Pratapgad, Shivneri, Hadsar, and Sagargad. Most departures offer pickup in Mumbai and Pune. Each listing states difficulty, what is included, and the price in INR.

A typical trek booking covers a guide, trek meals, camping gear, permits, and first aid. Transport and stay are listed on that departure.
